formulas.formula: Who paid, who owes, and the fewest payments to settle up.
Setup: the trip and everyone in the group. A couple sharing costs can be one line with weight 2.
Expenses: what was bought, how much, and who paid. Leave the name boxes empty to split with everyone.
Only some people in on it? Tick just their boxes on that line.
Balances: what each person paid vs their fair share.
Settle Up: the fewest payments to make everyone even. Tick each one when it's done.
Weight 2 = pays a double share (a couple, or someone staying longer).
Pick 'Paid by' from the list so the names match.
Settle Up pairs the biggest owers with the biggest creditors.
Splits can leave a cent or two. That's normal.
Good trips, even splits, still friends.
=IF(COUNTIF('Expenses'!$R$6:$R$305,"?")>0,COUNTIF('Expenses'!$R$6:$R$305,"?")&" expense line(s) need a look (red on the Expenses tab).","")
Leave the name boxes empty to split with everyone. Tick names to split only with them (weights still apply).
Paid = what each person put on their card. Share = their fair part of what they joined in.
The fewest payments to make everyone even. Tick Done as each one is paid.
=IF(COUNTIF(F7:F14,">0")=0,"Everyone is even. Nothing to settle!",COUNTIF(F7:F14,">0")&" payments settle the whole trip.")
=IF('Setup'!$R$5="","Add the trip dates on Setup to see spending by day.","Spending by day of the trip.")
